formulas.formula: Rent, leases, expenses and cash flow for every property in one place.
Setup: your name, the year and how many days of warning you want before a lease ends.
Properties: each unit with tenant, rent, due day, lease dates, mortgage payment, value and loan balance.
Rent Roll: type what each tenant paid each month. Short or late months turn red.
Expenses: taxes, insurance, repairs and more. Leave Property blank for shared costs. Maintenance: log repair requests.
Monthly, Property P&L and Dashboard update on their own.
A month counts as due once its due day has passed.
Net operating income: rent collected minus expenses, before the mortgage.
NOI minus the mortgage payments made so far this year.
Yearly NOI divided by the property's value. A quick way to compare places.
Green = paid in full or positive.
Red = owed, overdue or a typo.
Good tenants, steady rent and a growing portfolio.
